authorization_evidence: Owner confirmed in the active Codex task: confirmed. proceed with the corrected-v3 build.
scope: distinct corrected-v3 preregistration and restoration foundation only

roles.A_ref_mean: direct runtime composer input and HOLD/EXIT predicted mean
roles.A_ref_q10: direct runtime composer input, HOLD reliability lower bound, and joint monotone calibration member
roles.A_ref_q50: decision-critical transitive dependency of calibrated q10 and joint monotone calibration location
roles.A_ref_q90: decision-critical EXIT reliability upper-coverage support only; never a direct runtime utility term

aref_action_calibration_role.forbidden_quantile_claim: do not claim literal q10(-A_ref)=-q90(A_ref) without a tie-compatible quantile convention

training_topology.shared_read_only_contract: all A_ref bundles use the same frozen feature transform, A_ref target scaler, target-validity mask, row identities, weights, and earlier-session partition
training_topology.raw_noncrossing: q10 is the frozen action-bundle output; q50=q10+softplus(gap50); q90=q50+softplus(gap90), with detached frozen anchors during support fitting
training_topology.joint_calibration: the registered q10/q50/q90 monotone calibration is fit only after all three raw outputs are frozen; q50 may affect calibrated q10 only through this declared calibration edge

aref_action_calibration_role.sharpness_reporting: report q90 width and pinball performance versus the unconditional baseline as nonbinding diagnostics; coverage alone cannot support a tail-skill claim

composite_calibration_terminal_rule.chronology: validate every required fold-local calibration node before opening that fold; retain folds 1 through 5 sequentially; require an exact all-five VALID manifest before pooled or at-least-four-of-five economic evaluation

stage_scope.entry: entry B-R governs entry outer folds and preserves an immutable entry-only verdict
stage_scope.exit: known exit-weight counts [0,0,19,48,56] below 60 stop exit/combined evaluation before exit weights without erasing entry-only evidence
stage_scope.full_pre_holdout: instantiate only after outer entry PASS and validate before any protected-holdout open

composite_calibration_terminal_rule.nested_skip_rule: only a session-assignment block frozen calibration_valid=false may emit the lawful no-decode nested skip; a computed failure in a calibration-valid block is never relabeled as skip

failure_mapping.INVALID_TARGET_COVERAGE: invalid_result with failure-only terminal receipt and no scientific success receipt

composite_calibration_terminal_rule.required_node_registry: bind stage, fold or full scope, family/control identity, target/head/action, consumer, minimum, decision-critical versus diagnostic role, and failure mapping
composite_calibration_terminal_rule.economic_fold_gate: at least 4 of 5 always means at least four positive economic deltas among exactly five valid chronological folds
